dict.string: HourTrackers uses the camera only to photograph a printed timesheet so you can import clock-in and clock-out times.
HourTrackers needs photo access only to import a timesheet screenshot or image you choose.
Background location is used only to remind you to clock in when you arrive at the workplace you saved. We do not continuously track you.
Always location is used only for workplace arrival reminders. You can turn arrival reminders off anytime in Settings.
HourTrackers uses your location while using the app only to save your workplace when you tap Set Location.
